title: Opening of the Panama Canal
summary: The United States finished the Panama Canal on 15 August 1914, joining the Atlantic and Pacific oceans by an 80-kilometre waterway of two-lane locks. It followed the 1903 Hay-Bunau-Varilla Treaty, which granted a ten-mile-wide strip, and a French attempt that began in 1880 and failed with about 20,000 lives lost. Panama took over operation at noon on 31 December 1999.

uncertainty.note: The Embassy of Panama page gives 15 August 1914 as the date the United States "would finish" the canal; the State Department page says only "Completed in 1914".

importance.justification: The canal that joined the Atlantic and Pacific for shipping and shaped US-Panama relations for decades.
